note: The URLs of the three server functions the flue daemon calls, pinned across two languages. TanStack Start addresses a server function at /_serverFn/<id>, where <id> is sha256('<source file>--<exported name>_createServerFn_handler') in lowercase hex. Nothing in either codebase spells those URLs, and a rename or a move changes them silently — which breaks every daemon already installed, because the Go client hardcodes what it computes from the same two strings. So this file is the one written-down copy: app/test/enroll-e2e.test.ts asserts the built Worker serves exactly these paths, and Go's internal/controlplane TestServerFunctionPathsMatchTheApp asserts it derives exactly these paths from its own constants. Renaming a function fails the app test first, and updating this file then fails the Go test, which is the only order in which the coupling cannot be forgotten. Derived with: printf 'src/routes/enroll.tsx--startDeviceAuthFn_createServerFn_handler' | shasum -a 256
